section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1982
title: 12 ## Accidental Deaths by Sex Male victims of accidental deaths accounted for 65·9 per cent of the total accidental deaths in the country during 1982 while the female victims were 34·1%. The ratio of male and female victims for the States as a whole was 65·6% and 34·4% respectively while for the Union Territories as a whole it was 73·6% and 26·4% respectively. This percentage of male and female victims for the Metropolitan Cities as a whole was 66·3% and 33·7% respectively.
